answer: Raise sockpuppet costs with a bonded attestation ladder. A new identity locks a refundable quartz deposit for two epochs; it is released only after twelve established peers countersign distinct challenge answers. Each countersignature risks a slice of the reviewer's stake, slashed if an audit finds copied text or synchronized timing. To block burst farms, a reviewer observes a velvet cooldown of six hours after backing one freshman, and may endorse at most three new bonds in any 36-hour glacier interval. Bonds missing the attestation quorum are burned and paid to honest graders.
